name: Zombie
doc: Zombie (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks, not while any target task of 40 ticks or less runs), each a prim-model layout at the target's effect position scaled by its size, two of its objects drawn as additive quads; over ticks 30..59 the target redrawn lifted and swayed, flat additive from black to its tint, its entities marked from 30; the result at 54, the end at 60.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

wave.doc: s16 [4096]: the overlay's sway, indexed by its phase + the vertex's screen height x 4

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layout's blended vertex frames (after the three target nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn (not while any young one runs); each target task's clock: its sound, the target's mark, its result, its end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Mist
parts.doc: The layout at the target's effect position, scaled by its size, two objects as additive quads

parts.title: Overlay
parts.doc: The target redrawn lifted and swayed, flat additive in a colour going from black to its tint

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its drawing depth: (Base - the target's size word) >> Shift

groups.label: Size
groups.doc: Scaled by ((the target's size >> 1) + Base) >> Shift (4096 = its own size); the overlay's lift too

groups.label: Additive objects
groups.doc: These two objects of the layout are drawn as their gouraud quads only, additive (-1: none)

groups.label: Sway
groups.doc: Amplitude Base + Step x the step's 4096ths

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Busy tick
params.doc: Not while any target task is at this tick or before (the cycle restarts; -1: never)

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The target task ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Mark from
params.doc: The target's entities are marked (flags bit 3) from this tick to the end

params.label: From tick
params.doc: The target is redrawn swayed from this tick...

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: ...for this many ticks (its lift and tint: a quarter sine over them)

params.label: Lift shift
params.doc: Lifted by sin x the mist's size >> this

params.label: Phase step
params.doc: The sway's wave moves this much a tick

tasks.doc: One per action: from tick 30 the target's entities marked; the mist at the target's effect position now, scaled by its size (record flags 0x20000: angles in XZY order; 0x200: the anchor through the camera + the offset as is; 0x100: scaled by a diagonal matrix), objects 2 and 3 as their gouraud quads only, additive; over 30..59 (unless the cast's flags have 2) the target redrawn swayed; the sound, the result; at the end the mark cleared.
